verdict.rationale: Tavily is a web-data/API service (search, extract, crawl, map, research) that itself ships an official MCP server so agents can call ITS tools — the evidence never positions Tavily as an agent/orchestrator that consumes other MCP servers' tools. Plugging external MCP servers into a product only applies to agent hosts/orchestration platforms, not to a tool/API provider like Tavily, so this client-role axis is a category mismatch.
